description: Policy gating actions an AI support agent may take on a customer account.

variables.name: action_type
variables.description: The action the agent proposes to take.

variables.name: amount
variables.description: USD amount of a refund or payment. Zero or omitted when the action moves no money.

variables.name: has_human_approval
variables.description: A human supervisor has approved this specific action.

variables.name: customer_identity_verified
variables.description: The customer's identity was verified before the action.

variables.name: is_business_purpose
variables.description: The action serves a legitimate business purpose for the customer's own account (not personal, not for a third party, not a favor).

rules.description: A refund of 100 USD or less is allowed.
A refund over 100 USD without human approval is not allowed.
rules.condition: action_type == 'refund' AND amount > 100 AND has_human_approval == false

rules.description: Deleting customer data without verified identity is not allowed.
Deleting customer data without human approval is not allowed.
Making a payment without human approval is not allowed.
Any action that is not a legitimate business purpose for the customer's own account is not allowed.
A refund above 100 dollars is allowed with human supervisor approval.
rules.condition: action_type == 'refund' AND amount > 100 AND has_human_approval == true

rules.description: Deletion is allowed when identity is verified and a human supervisor approved it.
rules.condition: action_type == 'delete_customer_data' AND customer_identity_verified == true AND has_human_approval == true

rules.description: A payment is allowed with human supervisor approval.
